basePrompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: photorealistic isolated olfactory-note prop for a luxury Äura perfume product photograph.
Scene/backdrop: truly transparent background; the object rests on an invisible level studio tabletop.
Style/medium: exceptionally realistic macro product photography, natural irregularities and fine material texture, restrained refined styling. Front three-quarter angle at tabletop height, not flat lay.
Lighting: warm softbox daylight from upper left, believable directional shading, a clearly visible soft contact shadow falling toward the lower right; gentle ambient occlusion beneath the object. The object must look grounded, never floating.
Composition: a single small low compact arrangement, centered, occupying about 75% of the image width, ample transparent padding. Natural scale and low perspective matching a perfume bottle standing beside it.
Constraints: only the exact requested subject; no perfume bottle, no packaging, no text, no logos, no borders, no extra decorations. No colored background or large floor plane. Preserve real transparent alpha around the subject and its subtle shadow.
